newsitem.title: USA: Ecuador to issue two-part debt offering.
newsitem.headline: Ecuador to issue two-part debt offering.

text.p: Ecuador will issue a two-part global debt offering consisting of a five-year fixed rate issue and a seven-year floating rate note, a source close to the deal said on Thursday.
The source said the deal's structure is still being negotiated with the borrower.
On Wednesday, reports that Ecuador postponed its $300 million bond deal due to market conditions pressured some of the country's Brady bond instruments, Brady traders said.
The size of the deal, which initially was slated as $300 million, is now rumored to come as high as $400 million, market sources said.
"I'm hearing the Ecuador deal may come as high as $400 million," said one syndicate source.
The deal is rumored to be coming in the next few days, market sources said.
The five-year fixed rate issue is expected to come around spread of 475 basis points, and no price talk was available for the seven-year floater, syndicate sources said.
Chase Securities is expected to serve as lead underwriter for the offering, sources added.
